Aaron’s been a steady force in our DevOps team since 2021. At GameCraft, he’s the backbone of their SRE operations, handling everything from CI/CD to incident management with calm precision.  

He’s built a CI/CD pipeline that merges ArgoCD with Jenkins, cutting deployment times by 40% without sacrificing stability. His Jenkins setups are modular, making it easy for new devs to onboard without breaking existing workflows.  

When a critical outage hit last year, he triaged it in under 15 minutes, then rewrote the monitoring stack with Prometheus and Grafana. His Terraform templates for Kubernetes clusters have scaled across three teams, reducing configuration errors by 60%. He’s also the one who’ll flag SLA breaches before they hit thresholds, proactively tweaking alerts to balance noise and urgency.  

Aaron’s a rare blend of technical depth and calm under pressure. He’ll stay late to debug a tricky issue but also knows when to step back and let others shine. A pleasure to work with.
